messages: October 13 premarket report reconstructed after the market close from approved providers. Price/range inputs end before 09:20 ET; retrieval times are separate from observation times. This is a partial capture, not a complete frozen universe.

SPY and QQQ market-context levels use Robinhood actual 09:19 ET extended-hours bars and official October 12 closing prices. TradingView VIX uses its last 09:18 ET observation and the last observed October 12 bar; provider delays are unknown.

SPX is the approved OpenMarket HYPERLIQUID_HIP3 / xyz:SP500 synthetic perpetual proxy, not the cash SPX index. Its prior reference is the same instrument's October 12 15:59 ET bar. OpenMarket historical points supplied all 320 premarket minutes.

TradingView ES/NQ benchmark ranges have 920/920 completed overnight one-minute bars. YM and RTY Key Levels have partial observed coverage (905/920 and 911/920 slots); their levels are explicitly partial.

Robinhood public 100 most popular list was screened with its October 13 fundamentals: 46 U.S. common stocks with market cap at least $50B were discovered after excluding ETFs and identified foreign listings. This is incomplete discovery, not the full U.S. stock universe. Market-cap observations were retrieved after close.

Individual-stock ranges and last prices use Public.com as the approved equity fallback: all 320 premarket minute slots were supplied per stock. Only positive-volume trade bars contribute prices and session volume; flat zero-volume carry bars contribute no observations. Official October 12 closes and company metadata are from Robinhood. Provider delays are unknown; provider feeds can differ.

Tuesday's events and earnings remain listed despite having passed. Macro/Fed entries use Trading Economics; bill auction dates use U.S. Treasury's tentative schedule and times use Trading Economics. Earnings use Earnings Whispers with dated StockAnalysis evidence and the strict above-$25B filter.

Authorized additional fallbacks were tried in order: Yahoo Finance returned HTTP 429 for quote pages and minute-history requests; Trading Economics supplied timestamped pre-cutoff Treasury chart observations.

Trading Economics Treasury levels: 5Y and 10Y at 09:19 ET, 30Y at 09:18 ET, and 2Y at the start of its latest eligible 09:10 ET five-minute bar. References use the last observed October 9 bars because Treasury cash markets were closed October 12. Source resolution and actual timestamps are disclosed.

S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 quote/Key Levels displays now use the user-selected Trading Economics US500 (SPX:IND) and US100 (US100:IND) reference instruments. Their prior references use the same instruments. Internal ES/NQ record keys remain for compatibility; these display records are index references, not CME futures contracts.
US500 has 915/920 observed overnight minute bars and its range is partial; US100 has 920/920. Both last premarket observations are 09:19 ET. Yahoo Finance requests were rate-limited.
The scanner still uses its separately captured TradingView CME ES/NQ benchmark ranges. These reference-display updates do not alter scanner calculations.
Energy, Equity and Bond Commentary were supplied by the user. Overnight news remains empty.
